items.title: Sister Bernice Phillips Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: One of the sons learned to play music under Joe. He used to be around with all the colored people learning music.

ctx.x: Right there with him. He had one bad eye. I don't know if it was out, but it was swole out. You know, big eye they used to call him. And them wifey was crazy about him. He left from here. When music got good or waste, he had went away with a band somewhere and things was good there. And he left here. And I was still working for them people. And a long while after, they moved away to California. They would show people anyway. It's dangerous, but they would show people they'd be gone in a certain part of the year.…
Remember Zeb? Zeb, yeah, I know Zeb. What was his name? I could never get that straight.
